attendance.note: No attendance published. Organiser states capacity is 12,500 patrons (capacity, not attendance); the 2026 price page says capacity will not go beyond what the Supernatural Amphitheatre can comfortably hold.

ticket_price.note: Meredith 34: one ticket type, $541 including booking fee, covers camping and parking for 3 days and 2 nights. Sold via subscriber ballot, then online sales open to all on Thu 27 Aug 2026, then Aunty's Last Chance; now sold out with a waitlist.
